principles: Only fix the observed stale-job claim correctness gap.
Keep the server as the enforcement authority and the CLI as the signed intent declarer.
Preserve generic broad claims for paths that are not story-scoped.
Keep SSE advisory and never make stream hints lease ownership.
drivers: Server B-28c5 expects optional storyId/jobId inside the signed claim payload.
Autopilot and authority_enforce_runner live paths are story-scoped and know the intended story.
Existing smokes must prove the old claimed-job-story-mismatch class is gone without depending on staging state.

options.name: signed-story-selector-in-claim
pros: Keeps selector covered by actor signature
cons: Requires updating multiple live claim paths and smokes

options.name: client-release-and-retry-on-mismatch
pros: Could work with old server behavior
cons: Adds retry complexity and can churn stale queues

options.name: server-queue-purge-or-cancel
cons: Does not fix future broad CLI claims
Out of scope for CLI story

rationale: The CLI already knows the intended story in live runner flows, and the server now enforces signed selectors; sending storyId in the signed claim is the smallest correct fix.

preMortem.scenario: Selector is added only to one live path
preMortem.trigger: autopilot smoke passes but authority_enforce_runner still broad-claims
preMortem.consequence: Users still see stale job mismatch in another command
preMortem.mitigation: Patch and test both authority-job-loop-live and authority-runner live claim paths.

preMortem.trigger: reviewer accepts body snapshot but stale-job scenario remains unmodeled
preMortem.consequence: Original bug can recur with queued residue
preMortem.mitigation: Add a stale other-story queued job regression in existing smoke coverage.

preMortem.scenario: Selector is sent outside the signed claim
preMortem.trigger: storyId added as query param or unsigned top-level metadata
preMortem.consequence: Server cannot trust selector as actor intent
preMortem.mitigation: Keep storyId/jobId in signed JobClaim schema/payload only.
